name: Bidi cleaner
description: Removes the invisible direction marks (RLM, LRM, embeddings, isolates) and zero-width characters that text pasted from Word, WhatsApp or the web leaves in Hebrew and Arabic notes — in the selection, or in the whole note.
author: Lumen

capabilities.reason: Adds the “Remove invisible direction marks” command
To find the marks in the selection or the note
Writes the text back without them
Tells you how many were removed
